name: Philippines — 1 December 2026

sources.instructions:
Sources are the primary instrument first — the statute or regulation in the national law database, the gazette, or the table the authority itself publishes — one page per fact the version seals, never a news article or a commentary. A historical version lists the instruments in force on its own effective date. Where the primary host refuses the reader (sso.agc.gov.sg, officialgazette.gov.ph, peraturan.bpk.go.id, kwsp.gov.my, hrdcorp.gov.my answer 403 to Norbital-Public-Page-Reader) the authority’s own published table is listed instead, or the Wayback Machine’s dated copy of the authority’s own page or PDF (web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<url>) — never a host the reader cannot open.
officialgazette.gov.ph — the Official Gazette: Republic Acts, proclamations, executive orders. A proclamation is /<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/proclamation-no-<n>-s-<year>/ (HTML, full text); /section/proclamations/ lists the newest first; /nationwide-holidays/<year>/ is the holiday calendar. lawphil.net mirrors the same texts and is corroboration only.
sss.gov.ph — /pay-contribution/ carries the contribution schedule (the 2025 table PDF under /wp-content/uploads/ is 6.3 MB, over the reader limit: read the HTML page); /sss-circulars/ lists circulars by year.
philhealth.gov.ph — /advisories/<year>/ lists advisories; each is /advisories/<year>/PA<year>-<nnnn>.pdf (small, text). the premium schedule is PhilHealth Circular 2020-0005 (Revision 1), /circulars/2020/circ2020-0005.pdf (5 scanned pages, no text layer: §V.A the table, §V.B the equal employee/employer split), which each CY advisory cites; /partners/employers/ContributionTable_v2.pdf is the superseded 2019-0009 infographic and is not an authority.
pagibigfund.gov.ph serves a reCAPTCHA page, not the PDF: cite Circular 460 (15 January 2024, from February 2024; the 1%/2% tiers and the ₱10,000 fund salary cap) from its copy annexed to DMW Advisory 37-2025 (https://wcms.dmw.gov.ph/uploads/DMW_ADVISORY_37_2025_01225b9fec.pdf, 6 scanned pages, Circular 460 on pp.2–6), and Circular 275 from the Wayback copy (https://web.archive.org/web/2020id_/https://www.pagibigfund.gov.ph/document/pdf/circulars/provident/HDMF%20Circular%20275%20-%20Implementing%20Guidelines%20on%20Employer%20Registration%20Contribution%20and%20Remittance.pdf).
bir.gov.ph — bir-cdn.bir.gov.ph/local/pdf/Annex E RR 11-2018.pdf is the withholding table (monthly and semi-monthly columns, 0.3 MB); revenue regulation digests are under bir-cdn.bir.gov.ph/BIR/pdf/.
nwpc.dole.gov.ph — regional wage orders: /ncr/, /region-iva/ (and the other regions); /bwc-handbook-workers-statutory-monetary-benefits/ is the DOLE Handbook (factors, premiums, 13th month).
pco.gov.ph answers 403 to the reader; use the Gazette.

Finding changes (read these before comparing, every run):
Wage orders: read https://nwpc.dole.gov.ph/feed/ (RSS) for new RTWPB orders, then open https://nwpc.dole.gov.ph/statistics/summary-of-latest-wage-orders-issued-by-the-regional-boards/ and follow its 'Download PDF' (Latest-Wage-Order-Matrix-<date>.pdf, a text PDF with issue/publication/effectivity per region). Effectivity is 15 days after publication when the matrix leaves it blank. The regional pages (/ncr/, /region-iva/ …) link the signed wage-order PDFs. These are scans with no text layer, so take the figures from the matrix. SSS: newest CI number on /sss-circulars/, and the rate table on /pay-contribution/. PhilHealth: /advisories/<YYYY>/ and /circulars/<YYYY>/; premium changes are 'Premium Contribution … for CY<YYYY>' advisories. BIR: every www.bir.gov.ph listing (RR, RMC, WithHoldingTax) is a client-rendered shell ('Loading…'), so it cannot be read. Discover RR/RMC numbers from a big-4 alert list (PwC PH Tax Alerts, SGV/EY Tax Bulletin), then open the PDF at https://bir-cdn.bir.gov.ph/BIR/pdf/RR%20No.%20<n>-<yyyy>.pdf. Holidays: lawphil proclamation index for discovery only (officialgazette.gov.ph returns 403). Pag-IBIG and DOLE/BWC labor advisories are bot-walled: use news only to discover, and do not cite them.
Watch Wage Order No. NCR-27 (approved 23 June 2026: +₱60, then a second ₱25 tranche on 20 January 2027). NCR-28's recital says it never took effect under a status quo ante order, a TRO and a writ of preliminary injunction, and nwpc.dole.gov.ph/ncr/ marks it "subject to continuing litigation pending before RTC Pasig Branch 152 and RTC Navotas Branch 287". Read that page's NCR-27 notice on every check: if the courts lift the injunction, the 20 January 2027 tranche (and any restored NCR-27 rates) needs a new version from its effective date; NCR-28 (effective 26 September 2026) is not necessarily the last NCR order for that period.

change_summary: RR 29-2025 (dated 27 October 2025, posted on the BIR website 22 December 2025, in force fifteen days later, 6 January 2026; s.3): de minimis rice subsidy ₱2,000 → ₱2,500 a month and monetised unused vacation leave 10 → 12 days a year in the WTAX base. Later regional wage orders (to Wage Order No. RBV-23 second tranche, 1 December 2026) are dated entries of the PAYROLL rule `minimum_wage`, not versions.

benefit_cases.authority: RA 11210 ss.3 and 5 and its IRR: 105 days' maternity leave with full pay for a live birth, 60 for a miscarriage or emergency termination, 15 more for a qualified solo parent, at least 60 days after delivery; the SSS maternity benefit is the average daily salary credit (the six highest of the twelve monthly salary credits, capped at PHP 20,000, before the semester of contingency, divided by 180) times the compensable days, with at least three monthly contributions paid in that twelve-month window, for a contingency on or after 11 March 2019; the employer advances it within 30 days of the application and SSS reimburses it. DOLE Department Advisory 01-2019 ss.II–IV: the salary differential is full pay (monthly salary × days ÷ 30) less the employee's SSS, PhilHealth and Pag-IBIG shares and the SSS benefit, never negative; the exemption categories need DOLE approval. BIR RMC 105-2019: both are exempt from withholding. RA 11861 ss.15 and 20: the solo-parent identification card or eligibility certificate, first-time applicants within six months of the event.

limits.authority: Labor Code of the Philippines art.83

RA 10361 s.20: "an aggregate daily rest period of eight (8) hours per day", so at most sixteen worked hours in a day; a break is rest (https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/51514). The weekly rest (s.21, 24 consecutive hours a week) is met by `weekly_rest`, a rest after six consecutive work days (Labor Code art.91), which leaves no calendar week without one.
RA 9231 s.12-A(2) (https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/1388): a child fifteen but below eighteen works at most eight hours a day
RA 9231 s.12-A(2) (https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/1388): and at most forty hours a week

RA 12063 (Enterprise-Based Education and Training Framework Act) (https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/98026) s.13 and IRR IV.7: training is at most eight hours a day, and an adult trainee’s extra training at most two hours a day more

RA 12063 (Enterprise-Based Education and Training Framework Act) (https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/98026) s.13 and IRR IV.7: a minor trainee trains at most eight hours a day, with no extra training

night_premium.ordinary_add: day_type == "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" && holiday.kind == "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY" ? (rest_day ? 39.0 : 30.0) : rest_day && day_type == "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" ? 26.0 : rest_day && day_type == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" ? 15.0 : rest_day || day_type == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" ? 13.0 : day_type == "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" ? 20.0 : 10.0
night_premium.overtime_add: day_type == "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" && holiday.kind == "DOUBLE_HOLIDAY" ? (rest_day ? 50.7 : 39.0) : rest_day && day_type == "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" ? 33.8 : rest_day && day_type == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" ? 19.5 : rest_day || day_type == "SPECIAL_HOLIDAY" ? 16.9 : day_type == "PUBLIC_HOLIDAY" ? 26.0 : 12.5

work_rules.authority: Labor Code of the Philippines (P.D. 442, as amended) Book III: art.82 (coverage), art.83 (eight-hour day), art.85 (meal period), art.86 (night shift differential), art.87 (overtime), art.91 (weekly rest day), art.93 (rest-day premium) and art.94 (holiday pay), with Proclamation No. 1006, s.2025 for the 2026 regular holidays and special (non-working) days. art.86 and Handbook ch.5: the night shift differential is 10% of the hour’s own rate, so 13 on a rest day or a special day, 20 on a regular holiday, 26 on a regular holiday falling on the rest day, 15 on a special day on the rest day, and on the overtime hours of each 12.5, 16.9, 26, 33.8 and 19.5 (`night_premium` adds as expressions over the day; the first eight night hours of a rest day or holiday are its ordinary ones). Handbook ch.2 §D–E: a monthly-paid employee — one "paid every day of the month, including unworked rest days, special days, and regular holidays", declared on the contract as `terms.paid_rest_days` (applied 2026-09-23, round 4: the payroll group is the employer’s own label and states no law) — is prorated and has an absence deducted on the 365 factor, 30.4167 a month (`proration_by`); the daily-paid keep 21.75 or 26.0833. The night-differential ladder reads the day type (`day_type`, which the holiday takes under `holiday_rest_precedence: PUBLIC_HOLIDAY`); `holiday.kind` is the published row’s kind (PUBLIC | SPECIAL | SUBSTITUTE), and a day-type literal against it never matched. Handbook ch.2 §D, ch.3 §C, ch.4 §D state each day's pay as a total — a regular holiday worked 200%, a special day 130%, a rest day 130%, a regular holiday on the rest day 260%, a special day on the rest day 150%. The salary (261, 313 and 365 factors alike) and the daily-paid roster already pay a working holiday at 100%, so its first eight hours add the rest: 100% and 30% (`OT-2.0X`, `OT-1.3X`). The 365 factor (`terms.paid_rest_days`) also pays the rest day in the salary, so on it the rest-day rows add 30%, 160% and 50%; every other employee's rest day is unpaid and the rows carry the whole 130%, 260% and 150%. Hours beyond eight are paid by no base and keep their whole 169%, 260%, 338% and 195%. DOLE Handbook (2022) ch.2 §C: where two regular holidays fall on one day (a `DOUBLE_HOLIDAY` calendar row), the day is at least 200% of the daily wage unworked (`DOUBLE-HOLIDAY-UNWORKED`: a second day’s wage) and 300% worked (`OT-3.0X`: two more days on top of the day the wage pays); the guide computations (ch.4 §D) give 390% on a rest day (`OT-3.9X-REST`, 290% for the 365-factor employee, `terms.paid_rest_days`, whose salary pays the rest day), overtime 3 × 1.3 = 390% (`OT-3.9X`) and 3.9 × 1.3 = 507% on a rest day (`OT-5.07X-REST`), and night shift 10% of those rates (30, 39; overtime 39, 50.7). Ch.2 §D–E: an unworked regular holiday is paid only to an employee present, or on leave with pay, on the workday immediately preceding it (a rest or non-work day looks back further; two successive holidays pass the test through the first); `payroll.regular_holiday_prior_workday` applies it to the daily-paid wage and `holiday.prior_day_present` to the double holiday’s second day.

encashment.day_amount: terms.pay_frequency == "WEEKLY" ? terms.basic_salary / (terms.paid_rest_days ? 7.0 : terms.working_days_per_week) : terms.pay_frequency == "DAILY" ? terms.basic_salary : terms.pay_frequency == "HOURLY" ? terms.basic_salary * terms.ordinary_hours_per_week / terms.working_days_per_week : terms.basic_salary / (terms.paid_rest_days ? 365.0 / 12.0 : (terms.working_days_per_week >= 6.0 ? 313.0 : 261.0) / 12.0)
encashment.authority: DOLE Handbook on Workers Statutory Monetary Benefits, Service Incentive Leave, Conversion: salary rate on the conversion date, with pro-rata conversion. A daily contract supplies its daily salary; an hourly contract uses its normal scheduled hours per workday. Monthly equivalent factors follow paid-day coverage. Standing allowances require express basic-salary classification. https://nwpc.dole.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Workers-Statutory-Monetary-Benefits-Handbook-2024-Edition.pdf a weekly contract converts at the same salary rate on the conversion date — its week's wage over the days that wage pays: the working days of the week, or all seven where the contract pays the rest day too (the Handbook's monthly-paid/daily-paid distinction, Rules on EEMR factors 365 and 313/261, applied to a week).

tables.name: TERMINATION_GROUND
tables.label: Termination grounds: why a contract ended (employments.exit_ground)

tables.name: EBET_PROGRAM
tables.label: Enterprise-based education and training programs (RA 12063 s.4)

checks.message: Still recorded as probationary six months after starting work: an employee allowed to work after the probationary period is regular, so record regular terms from the day the sixth month ends.
checks.authority: Omnibus Rules Implementing the Labor Code (https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/85819) Book VI Rule I s.6(a), (d): probationary employment shall not exceed six months from the date the employee actually started working; an employee allowed to work after it is regular (Labor Code art.296, formerly art.281)

checks.message: Contracted as a trainee without a registered EBET program: record ebet_program (general training, apprenticeship or upskilling) before a trainee label changes any wage rule.
checks.authority: RA 12063 (Enterprise-Based Education and Training Framework Act) (https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/98026) s.4 and its IRR: enterprise-based trainees are classified by registered program; a blanket INTERN label does not remove the minimum wage

checks.message: The trainee type does not match the EBET program: an apprenticeship is contracted as APPRENTICE, and a general or upskilling program is not.
checks.authority: RA 12063 (Enterprise-Based Education and Training Framework Act) (https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/98026) s.13(b): only an apprenticeship trainee is paid on the 75% floor; s.13(a): a general trainee receives an allowance; s.12: an upskilling trainee keeps full wages

checks.when: employment.type == "INTERN" && "ebet_program" in terms.fact_keys && terms.facts.ebet_program == "GENERAL" && check.date >= add_months(employment.service_start, 6)
checks.message: Still recorded as a general EBET trainee six months after starting: general training lasts at most six months and training beyond it makes the trainee a regular employee, so record employment terms from the day the sixth month ends.
checks.authority: RA 12063 (Enterprise-Based Education and Training Framework Act) (https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/98026) ss.4(f), 22

employment_type.description: Labor Code arts.295–296 (regular, project, seasonal, casual, probationary), fixed-term employment, arts.58–72 apprentices, RA 12063 trainees and RA 10361 (Batas Kasambahay) DOMESTIC: a kasambahay takes ANNUAL_LEAVE_DOMESTIC, no company loan, the domestic wage floor and the household contribution rules.

work_classification.description: Labor Code arts.82 and 219(m): managerial employees are outside service incentive leave and PD 851 13th-month pay.

statutory_work_category.description: Labor Code art.82 field personnel and task-basis workers are outside service incentive leave; task-basis workers outside 13th-month pay, piece-rate workers inside it (PD 851 Revised Guidelines).

residency_status.description: NIRC ss.22(E)–(G), 24(A), 25(A)–(B). SSS refuses a citizen or permanent resident without a date of birth.

days_per_year.title: Days-per-year factor
days_per_year.description: The factor that turns the monthly basic into a daily rate (DOLE Handbook 2024 ch.2 §D–E): 365 when rest days, special days and regular holidays are paid; 313 on a six-day week; 261 on a five-day week; 305 / 253 where the special days are unpaid. Read by every day- and hour-rated line, retirement pay, the kasambahay pay, the WTAX leave ceiling and the minimum-wage-earner floor. Unrecorded is 313.

ebet_program.title: Registered EBET programme
ebet_program.description: Customer input. RA 12063 (Enterprise-Based Education and Training Framework Act) s.4: the programme an INTERN or APPRENTICE contract is enrolled in — general training (an allowance, no wage floor, s.13(a)), apprenticeship (75% of the floor, s.13(b)), upskilling (the full wage, s.12).

exit_facts.description: Stored on employment_contract.exit_facts when the contract closes (with the offboarding ground, last_day and note).

termination_cause.description: Labor Code arts.298–299 and DOLE Handbook 2024 ch.14 §C (customer input): the authorised cause. Labour-saving devices, redundancy and an impossible reinstatement pay a month a year; retrenchment, a closure not due to serious losses, disease, a security guard without assignment for six months (DO 150-16) and a contractor’s worker without assignment for three months (DO 174-17 s.13) half a month a year, at least a month; a closure due to serious losses pays none.

terminated_for_disease.description: Labor Code art.299: separation pay of one month or half a month a year, whichever is greater.

kasambahay_unjust_dismissal.description: RA 10361 s.32: fifteen days’ pay as indemnity.

kasambahay_unjustified_departure.description: RA 10361 s.32: up to fifteen days’ unpaid salary forfeited.

reference_number.description: The member number for the scheme: SSS number, PhilHealth Identification Number, Pag-IBIG MID number or BIR TIN.

covered_before_60.title: SSS member covered before sixty
covered_before_60.description: SSS standing election (RA 11199 s.9(a)): a member first covered before sixty keeps contributing while employed past sixty; unrecorded, no SSS, MPF or EC is charged from the sixtieth birthday.

facts.description: Person facts on employment_profile.facts (CEL employee.facts.*); the PH records read none.

entity_input_schema.title: PH entity inputs
entity_input_schema.description: entity.facts (CEL company.facts.*). The entity `region` column names the wage-order floor key of the PAYROLL rule `minimum_wage` (by_region, or by_employment_type.DOMESTIC for a household employer).

small_establishment.title: Regularly fewer than ten employees
small_establishment.description: Labor Code art.95(b); Omnibus Rules Book III Rule V s.1(e): outside service incentive leave.

retirement_exempt_establishment.title: Retail, service or agricultural establishment of ten or fewer
retirement_exempt_establishment.description: Labor Code art.302 (RA 7641): outside retirement pay.

bmbe_certificate_of_authority.title: Certified BMBE
bmbe_certificate_of_authority.description: RA 9178 s.8: a Barangay Micro Business Enterprise with a current Certificate of Authority is exempt from the Minimum Wage Law, so its non-household employees are not minimum wage earners for WTAX.

philhealth_employer_number.title: PhilHealth Employer Number (PEN)
philhealth_employer_number.description: RA 11223 s.10; its last digit picks the remittance window (PhilHealth Circular 0001 s.2014).

bir_tin.title: BIR TIN of the withholding agent

hdmf_remittance_group.title: Pag-IBIG remittance group
hdmf_remittance_group.description: HDMF Circular 275 §E.2: the first letter of the employer’s registered name picks the window in the month after the period — 1 = A–D (10th–14th), 2 = E–L (15th–19th), 3 = M–Q (20th–24th), 4 = R–Z or a numeral (25th to month-end). Unrecorded, the earliest window governs.

nsd_small_retail_exempt.title: Retail or service establishment of five workers or fewer
nsd_small_retail_exempt.description: DOLE Handbook 2024 ch.5 §B.2 (Labor Code art.86; Omnibus Rules Book III Rule II s.1): outside the night-shift differential. Unrecorded, the differential is paid.

minimum_wage_exemption_approved.title: Exempted from the wage order by the regional board
minimum_wage_exemption_approved.description: RA 6727 s.4(c): an establishment the regional wages board exempted from the wage order in force. Unrecorded, no exemption.
